description: Save a new message to Drafts without sending it.

account.description: Which mailbox to use. Defaults to the first. Pass the Mailbox shown in a list result when acting on that email.

attachments.description: Files to attach. Give content_base64, or from_email_id with attachment_id.

from_email_id.description: Reuse an attachment from this email (with attachment_id).

path.description: Path of a local file to attach.

body.description: The message in Markdown. Supports headings, bold, lists, tables, `> quote` (end with `> — Name` for attribution), callouts `> [!NOTE] Title`, code blocks, and buttons `[Label](https://url "button")`. Numbered lists render as steps.

format.description: "plain" sends text as written, without formatting.

signature.description: Append the mailbox signature. Default true; don't write a sign-off block yourself.

name: create_draft
